summary: Master workplace investigations and evidence handling with practical tools, defensible reports, and real case workflows. Enquire about 5-day training.
lede: Workplace investigation training helps HR, employee-relations and compliance professionals manage complaints through a structured, traceable process. It covers framing allegations, preserving and logging evidence, planning witness interviews, assessing corroborating and conflicting accounts, and writing reports that connect findings to evidence and policy. Learners also practice case tracking, confidentiality controls and escalation planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, support, or review workplace investigations and need a stronger process for handling evidence, interviewing witnesses, and writing defensible reports. It fits you if your role touches employee relations, disciplinary action, compliance review, or internal case management.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, access to basic document tools, and familiarity with your organization’s complaint, disciplinary, or investigation policy. If possible, prepare anonymized examples of a case file, interview notes, or an investigation report for workshop exercises.
